title: goniopteris scabra
intro: Goniopteris scabra, commonly known as the rough ginkgo fern, is a species of fern native to Asia, belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Goniopteris scabra include its ability to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
